result:
I made three fixes, but I haven't run any tests or type-checks, and I haven't checked any of them in a browser.

1. **Duplicate closes the sidebar.** In `InsightPanelActions.tsx`, the Duplicate button now calls `setScenePanelOpen(false)` right after starting the duplication. The panel closes as soon as you click, not when the copy finishes. This only closes the panel when it was opened manually (the narrow-screen case). If it is open because the Info side-panel tab is selected, it stays open. I didn't change the menu-bar Duplicate item in `InsightSceneMenuBar.tsx`, since a menu doesn't cover the insight.

2. **Back link on the transfer page.** The transfer URL only carries the numeric insight ID, but the insight page needs the short ID. `resourceTransferLogic.ts` now has a `sourceInsightShortId` loader that runs when the page mounts. For insights it looks up the short ID by numeric ID. `ResourceTransfer.tsx` then builds the Back link with `urls.insightView(shortId)`. While the lookup is loading, or if it fails, Back goes to `urls.savedInsights()`. I edited the inline typegen types in the logic file by hand. You may want to regenerate them.

3. **Narrow subscriptions modal.** In `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`, the featured empty-state card now uses a container query (`@container`). Below the `@sm` container width it stacks vertically and hides the hedgehog illustration. Above that width it keeps the illustration beside the text as before.

I didn't add or change any tests.
